name: Linen

spine.record: Authenticated work record with conversation, ownership, authority and outcome history

description: Employee service desk on TanStack Start, React and a Hono Worker with native D1 accounts and domain history, R2 attachments, Base local auth and Freshservice file migration.
nonGoals: Source publication is not hosted deployment or live provider acceptance.
Imported records and restored grants never confer permission to resume external effects.

externals.why: Worker runtime, D1 database and R2 attachment storage

env.name: DB
env.why: Native accounts, authority and domain data

env.name: ATTACHMENTS
env.why: Private attachments and retained source custody

env.name: SESSION_SECRET
env.why: Base authentication proof protection

env.name: ENCRYPTION_KEY
env.why: Encrypt provider configuration and retained erasure custody

env.name: APP_ORIGIN
env.why: Retained native origin compatibility; AUTH_ORIGIN takes precedence

deploy.notes: Lobby and native setup/sign-in are public; Linen application data requires a native scoped session. Deployment is blocked until the shared owner deploy contract can preserve existing Worker and storage identities.
